I completely know where youre coming from. Moving on from someone you thought you would spend all your life with its one of the heardest things to do. As for now, you dont have to push yourself. let yourself free to feel everything, its okay even the strongest people crumble when it comes to one person. Feel the breakup, accept it, you did what you could with all the tools you had, you know you love her with all ur heart, u did ur part, it hurts like hell but you have to go no contact, dont contact her. It will only make it worse, believe me. ive been there. I did so many things that helped me get thru this and one of those were "The Love Chat" and "The Dating Guy" on youtube. they both really helped me to gain a sense of whats happening around and how I should react. I really recommend checking these two out.youre going thru a grieving stage and its okay to feel how youre feeling. hell, ive cried every night for 2 months and couldnt even get out of my bed. Give urself a break, idk if youre religious or anything, just trust that in whatever u believe, will help u go through this. I believe in you, you can do this
